display.purpose: Hero titles only. Always uppercase. The glitch effect is applied exclusively at this scale.

headline.purpose: Section titles. Always uppercase. Minimum 1.25x size ratio below Display.

title.purpose: Subsection labels, project names, card headings. Mixed case.

body.purpose: Long-form text. Weight 300. Max 70ch line length.

label.purpose: Tags, nav items, metadata chips. Uppercase with 0.1em tracking.

shadows.name: glow-cyan-hover
shadows.purpose: Reactive hover glow on primary buttons and active interactive elements.

shadows.name: glow-card-hover
shadows.purpose: Diffuse card lift glow on hover. Structurally subtle — signals interactivity, not depth.

shadows.name: ambient-cyan
shadows.purpose: Background atmosphere circle — cyan. Fixed position, not tied to any element.

shadows.name: ambient-magenta
shadows.purpose: Background atmosphere circle — magenta. Creates depth alongside cyan.

shadows.name: ambient-yellow
shadows.purpose: Background atmosphere circle — yellow. Lowest opacity; tertiary presence only.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for all interactive state changes (button hover, card lift, nav link).

motion.name: ease-snap
motion.purpose: Sharper ease-out for scroll-triggered reveals and image scale transitions. Feels snappy.

motion.name: ease-ambient
motion.purpose: Background glow drift animation. Slow, continuous, loops infinitely.

motion.name: ease-glitch
motion.purpose: Glitch clip-path animation. Stepped, not eased — glitch is abrupt by nature.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.notes: Hamburger nav, single-column layout, 3D effects disabled, reduced particle density.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.notes: Two-column grid, 2.8rem headline scale, section padding 80px.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.notes: Max container width. Full three-column grids, 4rem headlines, 150px section padding.

narrative.overview:
This is a system built by someone who genuinely loves the craft. The glitch animations, rubber-band text, magnetic cursors, and starfield particles are not decoration — they are evidence. Evidence that the person who built this portfolio spent real time on each effect because it delighted them, not because a brief required it. That joy is the brand signal.

The palette is rooted in CMYK process printing: cyan, magenta, and yellow on a near-absolute black ground. Where print is static ink on a dark substrate, this site makes those same primaries interactive and alive. Future design additions should reinforce this logic: if an effect or color can't be traced back to 'this is how the materials behave,' reconsider it.

The intended audience — Polish SMB owners evaluating a designer to hire — should finish browsing and feel two things: admiration at the technical craft, and warmth toward the person who made it.
keyCharacteristics: Full-palette CMYK triad (cyan, magenta, yellow) on a printing-plate ground
Single geometric sans (Space Grotesk) across every role; hierarchy through scale and weight only
No box-shadows at rest; depth via tonal layering and ambient glow
Interactive elements that respond before they are touched (magnetic, proximity-aware)
Motion as evidence of craft, not decoration
Warmth through personality and specificity, not warm hue

rules.name: The CMYK Logic Rule
rules.body: Cyan leads interactions. Magenta occupies ambience. Yellow punctuates motion. These roles are not interchangeable.

rules.name: The One Darkness Rule
rules.body: The background is Studio Black (#050505) everywhere. Depth is Surface Raised and Surface Mid, not a second dark value.

rules.name: The Weight Jump Rule
rules.body: Minimum weight contrast between adjacent hierarchy levels is one full step: 300 to 500, or 500 to 700. Never 300 to 300 differentiated only by size.

rules.name: The Uppercase Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Display and Headline are always uppercase. Title and below are always mixed case. Uppercase body copy is prohibited outside Label contexts.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: box-shadow as a depth mechanism is prohibited. Elevation is tonal layering or state transforms. Reactive glow on hover is feedback, not depth.

rules.name: The Ambient Glow Rule
rules.body: The three ambient circles are background atmosphere only. Do not bring glow into the foreground as card halos or text glows.

rules.name: The Glitch-Once Rule
rules.body: The glitch effect is reserved for the hero title only. Applying it elsewhere dilutes the signal to noise.

dos: Do use Space Grotesk at weight 700 for all Display and Headline text. No exceptions, no second typeface.
Do use Electric Cyan as the primary interactive signal: link hover, button borders, active states, focus rings.
Do achieve depth through tonal layering (Studio Black → Surface Raised → Surface Mid) and ambient glow.
Do set Display and Headline type uppercase, Title and below mixed case.
Do cap body copy at 70ch max-width.
Do implement the magnetic proximity effect on primary CTAs.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: disable or simplify 3D transforms, particles, and rubber-band text.
donts: Don't build a site that reads as a generic Webflow template: whitespace-maximal, serif headline, scroll-reveal-only animation.
Don't create a corporate portfolio: no case-study templates, no bullet-pointed outcomes, no methodology sections that bury the work.
Don't use box-shadow as a depth mechanism. The No-Shadow Rule is absolute at rest.
Don't apply the glitch effect to any element other than the hero title.
Don't assign magenta or yellow to interactive states. Those roles belong to cyan.
Don't use weight 300 below 1rem on dark backgrounds.
Don't use glassmorphism as a default surface style.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent).
